description: My Position I grew up surrounded by strong and capable women who have had to work harder than I did to get ahead. My mom spent much of her life being told that “a woman couldn’t be an attorney”. And yet, she received her law degree and went on to become not only my role model, but one of the best

title: Empowering Women — Elect Dave Vella
